title: Free Inference
tagline: Free AI & LLM inference you can build with: an API key, a CLI login, or inference bundled inside a coding tool or builder. Speech-to-text, voice synthesis, code, vision, and reasoning. The test is whether you can ship an artifact you keep — code, an app, an audio file, a site, a design, an agent, a skill. Chat-only free tiers are excluded on purpose.

providers.name: Synap by Linkrra
providers.notes: Synap provides a no-card free tier for qwen3-coder-30b through an OpenAI-compatible API. Google or email sign-in grants 100,000 tokens and 50 requests per day, with a 10 requests/minute per-key limit.

providers.name: OpenCode Zen
providers.notes: OpenCode Zen provides a zero-cost promotional tier covering experimental open models across text and vision modalities. Developers authenticate via API key to query high-throughput endpoints directly without upfront billing. Access is bounded by limited-time promotional windows, a zero-data-retention policy, and fair-use concurrency caps.

providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.notes: OpenRouter offers permanently free models with 64K–1M context windows, translating to 50 requests/day (1,000 requests/day with + purchased credits). No credit card required.

providers.name: Google AI Studio (Gemini API)
providers.notes: Google AI Studio offers free model access with up to 1M context. Paid models like Gemini 4 Argon, Carbon, and Neon are excluded from the free tier. No credit card required.

providers.name: Groq
providers.notes: Groq offers 13 free models (9 LLMs, 2 Whisper STT, 2 Orpheus TTS), translating to up to 14,400 text requests/day and 2,000 audio transcriptions/day (~8 hours/day). No credit card required. Limits are pooled at organization level.

providers.name: Cerebras
providers.notes: Cerebras offers $5 trial credit across 2 models (gpt-oss-120b, qwen-3.8-27b with 8K context cap), translating to 1M tokens/day at 2,000+ tokens/sec. Credit card required. Trial credits expire in 30 days.

models.name: gpt-oss-120b
models.tpm: 30K (Uncached), 90K (Total), 1M TPH, 1M TPD via Free Trial limits table; context cap updated to 65k on free tier per documentation updates over prior 8k assumption

models.name: qwen-3.8-27b
models.tpm: 150K (Uncached), 750K (Total) via Free Trial limits table; context cap updated to 64k on free tier

providers.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
providers.notes: Cloudflare Workers AI is Generally Available with ~80 free models. No credit card required.

models.name: ~80 free models (Llama 3.x/4, Qwen, Gemma, DeepSeek-R1 distills, FLUX, Whisper, BGE embeddings)

providers.name: Mistral La Plateforme
providers.notes: Mistral provides a rate-limited free tier on La Plateforme for developers evaluating frontier and open models. Access is available via direct API key upon account registration with no credit card required upfront. Usage is bounded by default platform rate limits and standard evaluation terms of service.

providers.name: SambaNova Cloud
providers.notes: SambaNova Cloud provides a free developer tier when no payment method is linked, offering access to preview models like gemma-4-31B-it and gpt-oss-120b.

providers.name: NVIDIA NIM (build.nvidia.com)
providers.notes: NVIDIA NIM offers 1,000 free trial credits across catalog models with no credit card required.

providers.name: Z.AI (Zhipu)
providers.notes: Z.AI offers free API access to GLM-5.1, GLM-4.7-Flash, and GLM-4.6V-Flash with 128K context, translating to 15 requests/minute. No credit card required. Shared free tier throttles during peak platform traffic hours.

providers.name: DeepInfra
providers.notes: DeepInfra offers $5 signup trial credit across available models with no credit card required.

providers.name: GitHub Copilot (Free)
providers.notes: GitHub provides Copilot Free with limited features for individual developers, including inline suggestions limited to 2000 completions per month and Copilot Chat on GitHub.com and mobile.

models.name: Auto-selected (GPT-5 mini, Claude Haiku/Sonnet, Gemini Flash line)

providers.name: Kiro (AWS)
providers.notes: Kiro offers 50 free credits/month. Social account or AWS Builder ID required, no credit card required. Unused credits do not roll over.

providers.name: Trae (ByteDance)
providers.notes: Trae offers free inference. The free allowance includes 5,000 monthly autocompletions and a one-time $3 usage allowance. Usage is renewed monthly, and the credits are valid for 90 days. The free tier requires no credit card.

providers.name: Bolt.new
providers.notes: Bolt offers 1,000,000 tokens per month with a 300,000 daily token cap, translating to bundled frontier model inference for full-stack web and code generation via the Standard agent alongside hosting for up to 333k requests. No credit card required to sign up. Daily tokens reset every 24 hours without rollover, monthly quotas reset on the 1st of each calendar month, and free plan tokens do not roll over.

providers.name: Lovable
providers.notes: Lovable provides a rate-limited free plan for developers building full-stack web applications with daily build credits, daily chat allowances, and monthly Cloud/AI grants without upfront subscription cost.

models.name: Fable 5.1 (Frontier model)
models.tpm: Not specified000 tokens/day account allowance or standard limits via bundled access

providers.name: v0 (Vercel)
providers.notes: v0 offers a free plan granting 7 messages per day with bundled frontier models, plus a one-time $5 credit bonus for new accounts. No credit card required to sign up.

providers.name: Kaggle Notebooks
providers.notes: Kaggle offers free access to NVIDIA TESLA P100 and T4 GPUs with a weekly quota limit of 30 hours. Phone verification is required to unlock accelerators and internet access; no credit card required.

models.name: Open-weight models you load (GPU runtime)
models.context: Model-dependent (16 GB P100 / 2x16 GB T4 VRAM, 29 GB RAM)

providers.name: Hugging Face Spaces
providers.notes: Hugging Face Spaces provides 5 minutes of daily ZeroGPU compute on dynamic NVIDIA RTX Pro 6000 Blackwell GPUs along with free hosting for up to 2 Gradio Spaces.

models.name: Any Hugging Face model you load (ZeroGPU)
models.context: Model-dependent (up to 96 GB VRAM; 60s default / 120s max GPU duration per call)

providers.name: Cursor (Hobby)
providers.notes: Cursor provides a complimentary Free tier for developers, subject to monthly request allowances and rate limits. Third-party models are unavailable on Free and Plus tiers.

providers.name: Windsurf
providers.notes: Windsurf provides a free tier operating on a quota-based system with daily and weekly usage allowances, complemented by specific promotional free periods for models such as SWE-2 Flash, SWE-2, and SWE-2.1.

providers.name: Devin (Free)
providers.notes: Devin offers a Free plan with a light quota to code with agents, free use of SWE-2, unlimited inline edits, and unlimited Tab completions. Account login required, no credit card required.

providers.name: Qoder
providers.notes: Qoder offers free basic code autocompletions and limited Next-Edit-Suggestion (NES) runs. Account login required, no credit card required. Unlimited usage requires bringing your own API keys.

providers.name: Antigravity CLI (Google)
providers.notes: Antigravity CLI provides free developer inference for base and multimodal foundation models. Users run text, code, and reasoning tasks through local CLI and terminal workflows. Authentication is handled directly via Google account login without requiring a payment instrument, subject to dynamic request rate limits.

providers.name: Google Colab
providers.notes: Google Colab offers free access to hosted Jupyter notebook compute resources including shared GPUs/TPUs and integrated Gemini AI coding features, translating to interactive execution sessions of up to 12 hours with standard system memory. Google account login required (age 18+ for AI features), no credit card required. Resources and rate limits fluctuate dynamically, idle runtimes disconnect, and non-interactive background execution is disallowed.

models.name: Gemini (AI features) + GPU for your code

providers.name: Figma (Starter)
providers.notes: Figma Starter offers free AI generation credits and REST API/MCP access with no credit card required. Usage is capped at 150 credits/day and 500/month, resetting monthly.

providers.name: Canva (Free)
providers.notes: Canva provides free users with a recurring monthly allowance across standard and premium AI tools directly in the design canvas. Free usage excludes Ultra AI tools and paid enterprise API service accounts.

providers.name: Framer (Free)
providers.notes: Framer offers 500 one-time AI trial credits on its Free plan for workspaces without active subscriptions to power Framer Agents. No credit card is required to sign up.

models.name: Framer Agents
models.context: Canvas-native web design, layout, styling, CMS, and copy generation

providers.name: Replit (Starter)
providers.notes: Starter plan is deprecated for new signups, but existing Starter users retain limited Free Mode allowances and cloud credits.

providers.name: Kilo Gateway
providers.notes: Kilo Gateway offers free models with standard rate limits. No credit card required.

providers.name: Nous Portal
providers.notes: Nous Portal offers 3 free models with 50 requests/minute and 500,000 tokens/minute. Free account registration required, no credit card required.

providers.name: Cohere
providers.notes: Cohere provides free trial API keys for developers building with Command models. Users register an account to instantly retrieve trial credentials without entering a payment method. Usage is bounded by trial rate limits of 20 requests per minute and 1,000 API calls per month.

providers.name: Requesty
providers.notes: Requesty offers free models with 200 requests/day per account. Email registration required, no credit card required. Quota resets daily at 00:00 UTC.

providers.name: OVHcloud AI Endpoints
providers.notes: OVHcloud offers free playground testing and 10 free open-source models with keyless access, rate-limited to 2 requests per minute per IP.

providers.name: SiliconFlow
providers.notes: SiliconFlow provides $200 in free trial credits upon developer account registration. Credits can be applied across speech, text, and multimodal open-source models through an OpenAI-compatible API. Users create an account to generate API keys with no credit card required, with credits remaining valid for 90 days.

providers.name: DeepSeek Platform
providers.notes: DeepSeek offers an initial free grant balance upon developer account registration. Users access production deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner endpoints via OpenAI-compatible APIs without immediate paid top-ups. The platform automatically exhausts the granted balance first before requiring paid credits or subscription upgrades.

providers.name: Braintrust
providers.notes: Braintrust offers $10/month recurring model credit on Starter across 13 built-in models (including GPT-6 series, DeepSeek V4.1, GLM-5.3, and Jev). Work email required, no credit card required. Model credit resets monthly with no rollover.

providers.name: Deepgram
providers.notes: Deepgram provides $200 in free trial credits upon registration, unlocking public speech-to-text and text-to-speech models including Nova-3, Flux, and Aura. Developers register an account to obtain an API key with no credit card required upfront. The allowance yields roughly 700 hours of audio transcription, subject to a 90-day expiry window and standard streaming concurrency caps.

providers.name: AssemblyAI
providers.notes: New accounts receive $50 in free credits for Pre-recorded STT, Real-time STT, and Speech Understanding. No credit card is required to start.

providers.name: Dots Studio
providers.notes: The API is currently free of charge during a trial period without requiring a payment method or credit card. Model identifier shifted from dots-3-note-preview to dots3-note-prev.

providers.name: Liquid AI
providers.notes: Liquid AI provides promotional developer API credits upon registration in the Liquid developer console without upfront card requirements.

providers.name: Speka
providers.notes: Speka provides a $1 lifetime usage credit upon signup. Developers query all open catalog models via an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with a single API key created without a credit card. Usage is capped at 2 RPM.

providers.name: Alibaba DashScope (Bailian)
providers.notes: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (Bailian/DashScope) provides free token allotments upon account activation across its Qwen and DeepSeek model fleet. Developers access high-throughput OpenAI-compatible endpoints with up to 1M token context windows. API keys are generated in the Model Studio console after account registration, with promotional free tokens valid during designated trial windows.

providers.name: ModelScope
providers.notes: ModelScope (Alibaba's open-source model community) offers free hosted inference for community and Qwen open-weights models. Users query standard OpenAI-compatible completion endpoints with context windows up to 262K tokens. Access is activated by creating a ModelScope account to retrieve an API access token, subject to fair-share community queuing and rate limits.

providers.name: AMD Developer Cloud
providers.notes: AMD Developer Cloud provides free inference access to open frontier models running on AMD Instinct ROCm GPU clusters. Developers query OpenAI-compatible chat endpoints supporting DeepSeek, Qwen, and MiniCPM variants. Access is provisioned by registering an AMD Developer account to reach the API console, subject to cluster capacity and fair-use developer quotas.

providers.name: InferX
providers.notes: InferX provides zero-cost inference endpoints for open models including Qwen 3.6, Gemma 4, and DeepSeek variants. Developers access low-latency OpenAI-compatible completions with streaming and structured output support. Keys are provisioned instantly upon user sign-in without upfront payment, subject to community prototyping rate limits.

providers.name: Kimi For Coding (Moonshot AI)
providers.notes: Moonshot AI provides free developer inference for Kimi K3 and coding models with context windows up to 1M tokens. Developers query OpenAI-compatible coding endpoints supporting deep reasoning and agentic workflows. Credentials are retrieved via the Kimi coding portal, subject to community rate limits and peak-period concurrency throttling.

providers.name: SCNet
providers.notes: SCNet provides national high-performance computing open inference tokens for domestic LLMs including Qwen 3.8 and DeepSeek V4 Flash. Developers access OpenAI-compatible chat endpoints with up to 1M token context windows. Registration on the SCNet developer portal provisions API keys upon identity verification, subject to national computing quota rules.

providers.name: AIHubMix
providers.notes: AIHubMix provides a suite of zero-cost promotional models including GLM-4.7 Flash, Nemotron 3 Ultra, and Qwen 3.8 Max. Developers query OpenAI-compatible completion endpoints with long context support up to 1M tokens. Free API credentials are generated upon account signup without credit cards, subject to promotional token availability and rate limits.

secondary.name: Poe
secondary.notes: Free daily points reset every 24h with no rollover; the number is unpublished. Frontier models resold; login required, no card.

secondary.name: Dify Cloud (Sandbox)
secondary.notes: Sandbox: 200 message credits (one-off), 5 apps, 1 member. Provider models via Dify credits, then BYO key; no card.

models.name: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, xAI, Tongyi (via Dify credits)
